name: Commerce GMO LinkTypePlus
description: Drupal Commerce off-site payment gateway for the GMO Payment Gateway (Mul-Pay) LinkTypePlus hosted payment page.
project_description:
Commerce GMO LinkTypePlus module that will make use of the link type plus offsite payment method in Drupal commerce. Its written on top on Drupal commerce as an payment gateway plugin extension. It also uses a custom payment workflow.

 Features 
 LinkTypePlus module can be used an extension to the Drupal commerce payment gateway that will make use linktypeplus GMO API's to connect and create payments in the vendor site.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, configure the new payment gateway on: /admin/commerce/config/payment-gateways 

Select the workflow at: /admin/commerce/config/order-types 

 Additional Requirements 
 This project have no additional requirements other than Drupal commerce .
